IntroPage.title: Operational intelligence for MODON's industrial cities
IntroPage.subtitle: A unified view of the industrial base across MODON — factories, sectors, and infrastructure — turned into clear, decision-ready insight.

industries.title: Industry analysis
industries.description: See the leading and smallest manufacturing sectors ranked by factories, share, and city coverage.

cities.title: Industrial cities
cities.description: Understand how activity is distributed across MODON's industrial cities and zones.

network.title: Infrastructure
network.description: Track the supporting utility and services network that keeps the industrial base running.

demand.title: Demand analysis
demand.description: Track customs trade demand into MODON cities — import weight, origins, product chapters, and monthly trends.

gapAnalysis.title: Gap analysis
gapAnalysis.description: Track manufacturing gaps, localization opportunities, regional readiness, and prioritized industrial action.

DemandPage.title: Demand analysis
DemandPage.subtitle: Customs declarations linked to MODON industrial cities — trade weight as the primary signal of input demand and output flow across the network.
DemandPage.emptyState: No trade recorded for this selection.
DemandPage.mapSubtitleImport: Marker size reflects inbound cargo weight across MODON industrial cities for the current selection.
DemandPage.mapSubtitleExport: Marker size reflects outbound cargo weight across MODON industrial cities for the current selection.
DemandPage.mapTokenMissing: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN to .env.local to enable the map.
DemandPage.mapEmpty: No mapped cities for this selection.
DemandPage.comparisonNone: No earlier period available for comparison
DemandPage.insightsSubtitle: Signals derived automatically from the current selection.
DemandPage.insightRankBody: {name} ranks {rank} of {total} partners in this period, carrying {share} of total weight.
DemandPage.insightConcentrationCountryBody: The top {topN} partners carry {topShare} of all weight, with {leader} alone at {leaderShare}.
DemandPage.insightConcentrationChapterBody: The top {topN} product chapters carry {topShare} of this trade, with {leader} alone at {leaderShare}.
DemandPage.insightMomentumBody: {name} grew {delta} against the comparison period, reaching {weight}.
DemandPage.insightDeclineBody: {name} fell {delta} against the comparison period, down to {weight}.
DemandPage.insightBalanceBody: Imports of {imports} against exports of {exports} — a {direction, select, surplus {surplus} deficit {deficit} other {balance}} of {net}, with export coverage at {coverage}.
DemandPage.insightShipmentBody: Consignments average {avg} t, roughly {factor}× {comparison, select, heavier {heavier} lighter {lighter} other {different}} than the {benchmark} t network norm.
DemandPage.insightImportersBody: {count} registered businesses filed declarations in this period.
DemandPage.insightImportersBodyDelta: {count} registered businesses filed declarations, {delta} against the comparison period.
DemandPage.trendSubtitle: Net weight per month, with the comparison period overlaid.
DemandPage.balanceSubtitle: Import against export weight for this selection
DemandPage.modeSubtitle: Weight split across sea, land and air gateways
DemandPage.shipmentSubtitle: Mean net weight per customs declaration
DemandPage.profileSubtitle: Rank {rank} of {total} partners · {share} of network weight · {period}
DemandPage.originsSubtitle: Select a country to filter the whole page
DemandPage.destinationsSubtitle: Select a country to filter the whole page
DemandPage.citiesSubtitle: Cities receiving the most inbound cargo by weight
DemandPage.citiesSubtitleExport: Cities shipping the most outbound cargo by weight
DemandPage.hsSubtitle: Harmonized System chapters ranked by weight
DemandPage.portsSubtitle: Gateways handling the largest share of inbound weight
DemandPage.portsSubtitleExport: Gateways handling the largest share of outbound weight
DemandPage.sankeySubtitleImport: How inbound weight moves from origin countries through product chapters and ports of entry into industrial cities. Click a country to filter the page.
DemandPage.sankeySubtitleExport: How outbound weight moves toward destination countries through product chapters and ports of exit across industrial cities. Click a country to filter the page.
DemandPage.sourceNote: Based on {count} customs declarations (imports and exports) linked to MODON industrial cities.

IndustriesPage.title: Industries in MODON
IndustriesPage.subtitle: A snapshot of the industrial base across MODON cities, ranked by the number of factories in each manufacturing sector.
IndustriesPage.sourceNote: Source: MODON GIS parcel layer (105) and utility network (77). Ranking covers standard manufacturing sectors.

MapPage.title: Industrial cities map
MapPage.subtitle: Explore MODON's industrial cities across the Kingdom — click a marker to see factory counts at each location.
MapPage.tokenMissing: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN to .env.local to enable the map.
MapPage.sourceNote: City locations are approximate. Factory counts shown on markers are illustrative until live GIS data is connected.

GapAnalysisPage.title: Gap Analysis
GapAnalysisPage.subtitle: A national view of manufacturing performance, trade gaps, localization opportunities, regional readiness, and prioritized industrial action.
GapAnalysisPage.sourceNote: Current view uses the app's existing industrial datasets, presented through a temporary gap-analysis adapter until a dedicated gap analytics service is available.
